About Pharmacare

Bringing dermatology-led skincare to Sri Lanka

Pharmacare (Pvt) Ltd is a Mount Lavinia-based healthcare company that markets and distributes the SKIN23 Dermatology portfolio. We work hand in hand with pharmacists, doctors and distribution partners so that every patient and customer receives genuine products, reliable advice and consistent supply.

01

Genuine & traceable

Every pack is supplied through our own network, with batch number and expiry recorded on each invoice and stock rotated earliest expiry first.

02

Science that cares

Formulations built around ingredients with published evidence, presented honestly, with clear guidance on how and when to use them.

03

Partners in care

Product education for healthcare professionals, regular field visits and responsive service for pharmacies, clinics and distributors.

Experience

More than 10 years in Sri Lanka's pharmaceutical and dermatology market, with a team that understands how skincare is prescribed, recommended and bought here.

Medical network

Working relationships with more than 200 doctors across the island, including dermatologists, general practitioners and aesthetic clinics, built through regular scientific detailing.

Distribution

Eight leading distributors and our own field team cover all nine provinces and all the key pharmacies in the country, with batch-tracked stock and earliest-expiry-first rotation.

Promotion

Professional promotion by trained medical representatives, product education for doctors and pharmacists, and in-store support that turns recommendations into results.

R&D and global sourcing

We source from pharmaceutical suppliers with their own research and development across ten countries, including Europe, selecting formulations with evidence-based actives matched to Sri Lankan skin and climate.

Lasting relationships

Partnerships built on trust: fair terms, reliable supply and responsive service for every pharmacy, doctor and distributor we work with.

Morning

Cleanse, brighten, protect

Three steps before you leave the house.

  1. 01
    Clarera Cleansing GelSoap-free, pH-balanced cleanse to remove excess oil and impurities.
  2. 02
    Feru-C Vitamin C Serum20% L-Ascorbic Acid antioxidant serum for brighter-looking skin.
  3. 03
    Solara SPF 50+ Day CreamBroad spectrum UVA + UVB protection. Works under make-up as a primer.
Night

Cleanse, treat, replenish

Three steps before bed.

  1. 01
    Clarera Cleansing GelRemoves sunscreen and the day's buildup.
  2. 02
    Agease Night SerumOvernight repair for fine lines, skin tone and hydration.
  3. 03
    Noctera Night Repair CreamA pea-sized amount to face and neck. Avoid the eyes.

Targeted care: Ocura around the eyes and Pigmentra on dark spots, after serum. Body and hair: Glycera bar and Striease lotion daily, and Melantra on the scalp (4–6 drops, massaged in, not rinsed). Noctera contains retinol, so avoid combining it with other retinoids. Ask your doctor or pharmacist which steps suit your skin.
